2 days Taj Mahal overnight tour

Delhi · Agra · Overnight · 2 days

2 days Taj Mahal tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Agra at a human pace from Delhi: the Baby Taj and sunset at Mehtab Bagh on day one, the Taj Mahal at sunrise on day two, and home by evening.

At a glance

Duration
2 days, 1 night
Destinations
Agra

Private AC car
Accommodation

Hotel or airport in Delhi NCR

What makes this one worth it

  • Pickup from Delhi, Noida or Gurgaon and back again
  • Sunset over the Taj from Mehtab Bagh
  • The Taj Mahal at sunrise with your guide
  • Itimad-ud-Daulah, the Baby Taj, and Agra Fort
  • One night in Agra, so nothing is rushed

Your day by day

  1. Day 1 · 8:00 AM

    Delhi to Agra

    Pickup from your Delhi hotel or the airport and about three hours to Agra on the Yamuna Expressway. Check in and rest.

  2. Day 1 · Afternoon

    The Baby Taj and Mehtab Bagh

    Itimad-ud-Daulah, the quieter marble tomb known for its inlay, then Mehtab Bagh across the river to watch the sun go down behind the Taj.

  3. Day 2 · Sunrise

    The Taj Mahal at first light

    Back at the Taj Mahal gate before sunrise with your guide, for the monument at its quietest.

  4. Day 2 · Morning

    Agra Fort

    Breakfast and checkout, then Agra Fort — the Mughal palaces and the terraces that look out over the river to the Taj.

  5. Day 2 · Afternoon

    Back to Delhi

    The drive back to Delhi, arriving late afternoon or early evening at your hotel, the airport or any address you choose.

What the price covers

  • One night in a 4-star hotel with breakfast
  • Private AC car and chauffeur from Delhi and back
  • Licensed guide for both days
  • Taj Mahal and Agra Fort tickets
  • Bottled water, tolls, parking and taxes

What it does not cover

  • Lunch and dinner
  • Baby Taj and Mehtab Bagh tickets
  • Camera fees
  • Tips

Questions people ask

What hotel categories are available for this tour?
You can choose a three-star, four-star or five-star hotel in Agra. If you would rather book your own room, we can run the tour without a hotel.
How many nights of accommodation are included?
One night in Agra when you pick a hotel option, with breakfast and taxes included.
Are monument entrance fees included in the tour price?
Yes. Taj Mahal and Agra Fort tickets are included in the price, and your guide handles them at each gate so you skip the ticket queue.
Can I customise the hotel or upgrade my stay?
Yes. We can match the hotel to your taste and budget, and upgrades to a higher category are available on request when booking, subject to availability.
Is this a private overnight tour from Delhi to Agra?
Yes, it is completely private, with a dedicated AC car, driver and licensed English-speaking guide on both days and no shared groups.
